Summary:
Companies setting up a business-to-business marketplace to make transactions more efficient for buyers and sellers should carefully consider the best ownership structure. New research suggests that owning the marketplace outright can give a company greater control, security, and access to suppliers but can also create regulatory problems and channel conflicts. Depending on the business objective, creating a spinoff or startup can be an effective strategy for launching a B2B marketplace.
Business-to-business
marketplaces, like their consumer-facing cousins, help streamline purchasing by giving buyers and suppliers an online platform for conducting transactions. Once a company decides that it wants to create a marketplace to make transactions more efficient and extend its market reach, it must start by deciding on an ownership structure: Should the marketplace be kept in-house or spun out as an independent business? And is it worth bringing in partners or other owners?
Each type of structure has its advantages and disadvantages, and which is the best option will depend on several factors, including how fragmented the market is, the costs and benefits of independence from the parent company, and the value that outside investors or partners may bring.
We surveyed 200 B2B marketplaces to understand the key challenges and success factors they had encountered. We found that such marketplaces are typically set up in one of three ways. Slightly more than half the respondents (51%) were pure startups, usually established by independent investors to serve highly fragmented markets. Nearly a third (30%) were owned and operated as internal company units, while about 1 in 5 (19%) were corporate spinoffs that started in-house and later separated as independent companies.
These formats are dynamic, not static: A marketplace may start as an internal unit and be spun off as it matures, and a pure startup might later be acquired and integrated into a corporation’s operations.
Internal Versus External Marketplaces
Internal marketplaces enjoy the security, infrastructure, and access to clients inherent in being part of a large corporation. Sysco, a global wholesale distributor to the food service sector, launched an online marketplace as an internal venture last year. The structure makes sense: The marketplace is largely complementary to Sysco’s current offerings and allows the company to extend its portfolio of products and vendor relationships, greatly increasing customers’ options.
But internal marketplaces can also face a few challenges. One is channel conflict. A company that creates a B2B marketplace risks cannibalizing its other marketing and sales channels. Of course, this is true for both internal and external marketplaces, so at least in this case, the company benefits from increased efficiency and market reach. It’s often a case of “do it before others do it to you.”
Spinoffs enjoy one main advantage over startups: access to the corporate mothership’s technology, expertise, and capital.[

data.title: Why is there a "small house" in IBM's Code page 437?
data.author: m_walden
data.article_summary: 这篇文章探讨了IBM PC的Code Page 437字符集中位于0x7F位置的“删除”（DEL）字符为何被显示为一个小房子（⌂）。在ASCII标准中，DEL字符本应用于删除不需要的字符，但没有明确的视觉表示。IBM PC的设计者们在一次短暂的飞机旅行中快速决定将这些控制字符赋予有趣的图形，包括笑脸、扑克牌花色、音符等，以用于文本游戏。因此，DEL字符也被归入这些“非严肃”字符之列，显示为一个小房子。这种做法背离了传统标准，如ANSI X3.32-1973，但使得字符集更具趣味性和实用性，适应了当时个人电脑的需求。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：ASCII符号（特别是0x7F字符）的含义和用途

不同观点：
• **layer8**：认为该符号类似于缩进标记或打字机上的物理标记，提供了多个历史软件和硬件的参考链接，如Atlantis Word Processor和GeoWrite。
• **1970-01-01**：认为该符号未被充分利用，其意义由程序员赋予，可以作为三角形或房屋使用，没有明确固定的意义。
• **susam**：强调VileR的网站对保存旧技术时代各种PC OEM字体的贡献，赞赏其对该领域的深入研究和资源整理。

• **dhosek**：指出非文本字符的意义往往是模糊的，提到关于Wingdings字体反犹信息争议的例子。
• **anonymousiam**：回忆起20世纪70年代末至80年代初的终端和打印机经验，指出0x7F字符常被渲染为格子框。

• 争议焦点在于0x7F字符的具体意义，有观点认为是delta，有观点认为是房屋，也有观点认为其意义模糊，由使用者决定。
• 讨论中多次提到VileR的网站，显示其在保存和研究旧技术字体方面的重要性。

43667010.article_content:
#Essay
#ASCII Art
#Fonts
#History
Note:
This post is a companion piece to my article
The origins of DEL (0x7F) and its Legacy in Amiga ASCII art
. That article is all about the character DEL, what it is, how it was used, and why it even has a visual representation, but with a focus on Commodore's Amiga computers. Whereas AmigaOS's Topaz font renders DEL with diagonal lines, IBM's PC renders it... as a house. This bonus article is about that.
This article wouldn't have happened without the great help and insights of
Michael Walden
and
VileR
, thank you!
If you want to comment on something (minor or major), please send me an email at
hlotvonen@gmail.com
. I would greatly appreciate it, and if something needs fixing I would gladly update the article with proper credit.
a-b-c-d-x-y-z...HOUSE?
There's a small house (
⌂
) in the middle of IBM's infamous character set Code Page 437.
"Small house"
—that's the official IBM name given to the glyph at code position 0x7F, where a control character for "Delete" (DEL) should logically exist. It's cute, but a little strange. I wonder, how did it get there? Why did IBM represent DEL as a
house
, of all things?
IBM PC's Code Page 437
The rise of Code Page 437
Released in 1981, the
IBM Personal Computer
(PC) launched IBM's first microcomputer model line. Alongside it, they introduced an 8-bit character set, which later became known as
Code Page 437
(CP437). Unlike earlier IBM machines, the PC was built using off-the-shelf components instead of proprietary IBM technology, which spawned a wave of third-party clones marketed as "IBM-compatible" systems. IBM PC architecture quickly became the dominant global computing standard. By the end of the '80s, 84% of all sold microcomputers were either IBM PC's or its clones.
[1]
The rise of PC also meant the widespread adoption of CP437, making it one of the most copied and recognizable character sets ever. VileR's
Ultimate Oldschool PC Font Pack
lists over 200 fonts based on CP437 from various IBM PC models and their clones.
CP437 was based on
American Standard Code for Information Interchange
(ASCII), which defines the first 127 characters. This was a big change for IBM who had previously used the fundamentally different EBCDIC standard. But as ASCII covers only 96
printable
characters of the total 256 available in 8-bit code, IBM had to figure out what to do with the rest of them. Instead of basing their choices on any predefined standards extending ASCII, or copying others, they decided (yet again) to do their own thing.
A set of "not serious" characters
The extended bits (characters 128–255) of CP437 contain mainly a mishmash of international text characters, box drawing shapes and mathematical symbols. But for the undefined control characters they did something wildly different. Dr. David J. Bradley, one of the creators of the IBM PC, recounts the
origins of the ASCII smiley character
in an email conversation with Benj Edwards of
vintagecomputing.com
:
"Now, what to do about the first 32 characters (x00-x1F)? ASCII defines them as control codes, carriage return, line feed, tab… These characters originated with teletype transmission. But we could display them on the character based screens. So we added a set of “not serious” characters. They were intended as display only characters, not for transmission or storage. Their most probable use would be in [text] character based games."
[2]
The first 32 characters (x00-x1F) of CP437 mentioned by Bradley include smileys, playing card suits, musical notes, a solar symbol, gender symbols and arrows. What Bradley doesn't explicitly mention is the character at 0x7F, which is also a (sort-of) control character used in teletype transmission. It's assigned to the Delete character, which was used to obliterate undesirable characters on paper tape by punching it full of holes. The all-holes pattern in ASCII is at the 127th code point, represented by 0x7F in hexadecimal. This character is like all the other 32 control characters in that it doesn't have a defined visual representation, nor any particular use in digital computers like the IBM PC. So, even though Bradley doesn't explicitly mention 0x7F, it's represented in CP437 as a tiny pixel-house (
⌂
), suggesting it also belongs to the "not serious" group of characters.
The "not serious" characters
According to Bradley, the "not serious" characters were developed during a 4-hour plane travel. He's of course exaggerating, but gave it as an "indication of the rapidity in which many significant decisions were undertaken". But even though they developed them relatively quickly, they must have based them on
something
.
What is this something? IBM could have followed an existing standard and taken the graphics for control characters from ANSI X3.32-1973—but they are ambiguous and hard-to-use (see part 2 of
The origins of DEL (0x7F) and its Legacy in Amiga ASCII art
). Instead, going with these "not serious" characters was arguably a better choice, espe

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Apple Music应用的用户体验、功能使用及相关技术细节

不同观点：
• [sillywalk] 认为 Apple Music 的用户界面设计不合理，尤其是在搜索功能、本地/下载内容切换、返回/前进按钮设计以及默认视图等方面存在问题。例如，搜索需要滚动到顶部，切换按钮位置不合理，默认视图占据了屏幕一半空间，且包含不必要的空白区域。

• [pretext-1] 和 [thehoff] 则对 ambient music 功能的使用进行了讨论。[pretext-1] 纠正了 ambient music 功能必须依赖 Music 应用的误解，指出该功能有独立的轻量级媒体播放界面。[thehoff] 则以个人经验支持了这一观点，表示自己没有安装 Apple Music，ambient music 功能依然正常工作。

• [mgkimsal] 补充提到 ambient music 和背景噪音功能可以同时运行，并认为这种组合效果很好，提供了更好的用户体验。

• [pram] 推荐使用 iTunes Match 订阅服务来上传和同步自己的音乐收藏，认为这是 Apple Music 应用的最佳功能之一，并提供了相关支持链接。

• [damnesian] 关心是否有类似 Apple Music 的 Linux 平台应用，表达了对跨平台背景音乐工具的需求。

• [dangus] 从更宏观的角度讨论了 Apple Music 应用和订阅服务之间的区别，批评了 Apple 在命名和营销上的混淆。同时指出，Apple 依然提供了相对完整的音乐管理和同步功能，并认为这些功能在当前数字音乐市场上已经变得稀缺。

补充讨论：
• Apple Music 应用和 Apple Music 订阅服务之间的混淆是用户常见的困惑点，导致一些不必要的误解和争论。
• 不同用户对 Apple Music 界面设计和功能实现的体验差异较大，部分用户对其界面设计不满，而其他用户则关注其功能实现和跨平台需求。
• 关于 ambient music 功能是否依赖 Apple Music 应用的争论是评论中的一个小焦点，不同用户基于个人经验给出了不同的答案。

data.article_summary: 一项新的基因组研究从超过一百万年的猛犸象谱系中发现了长期失落的遗传多样性。研究人员成功提取并分析了34个新的猛犸象线粒体基因组，其中包括来自早、中更新世的样本。研究结果揭示了猛犸象进化历史中的多样化事件，并支持猛犸主要谱系起源于古代西伯利亚的理论。通过与200多个已发表的猛犸象线粒体基因组进行比较，研究显示人口动态变化可能导致不同遗传支系的扩张和收缩。该研究还开发了一种改进的分子钟测年框架，为古DNA研究提供了新工具。这些发现加深了对猛犸象遗传多样性变化的理解，并对古代DNA研究领域做出了重要贡献。

Science News
from research organizations
Mammoth genetic diversity throughout the last million years
Date:
April 9, 2025
Source:
Stockholm University
Summary:
A new genomic study has uncovered long-lost genetic diversity in mammoth lineages spanning over a million years, providing new insights into the evolutionary history of these animals.
Share:
Facebook
Twitter
Pinterest
LinkedIN
Email
FULL STORY
A new genomic study has uncovered long-lost genetic diversity in mammoth lineages spanning over a million years, providing new insights into the evolutionary history of these animals.
The new study has successfully extracted and analysed 34 new mammoth mitochondrial genomes (mitogenomes), including specimens dating back to the Early and Middle Pleistocene geological periods. A total of 11 specimens come from these periods, with their ages spanning from 1.3 million to 125 000years ago. The findings, published in
Molecular Biology and Evolution
, shed light on mammoth evolutionary history and demonstrate the power of ancient DNA in characterising past genetic diversity.
"Our analyses provide an unprecedented glimpse into how major deep-time demographic events might have shaped the genetic diversity of mammoths through time," said Dr J. Camilo Chacón-Duque, researcher at the Department of Zoology, Stockholm University, and Centre for Palaeogenetics and lead author of the study.
A million years of mammoth evolution
Most of today's biodiversity evolved during the last 2.5 million years. Understanding the evolutionary processes that shaped this diversity requires access to genetic information throughout this timeframe. Until now, very few DNA samples have surpassed the 100-thousand-year threshold due to preservation challenges. By recovering DNA from mammoth specimens spanning over more than a million years, this study showcases the importance of temporal sampling to characterise the evolutionary history of species.
By analysing these new mitogenomes alongside over 200 previously published mammoth mitogenomes, the researchers were able to find that diversification events across mammoth lineages seem to coincide with well described demographic changes during the Early and Middle Pleistocene. Their findings support an ancient Siberian origin for major mammoth lineages and reveal how shifts in population dynamics might have contributed to the expansion and contraction of distinct genetic clades.
"With the ever-decreasing costs of sequencing technologies, mitogenomes have been somewhat forgotten. However, our study shows that they remain crucial for evolutionary biology since they are more abundant than nuclear DNA," said Dr Jessica A. Thomas Thorpe, researcher at the Wellcome Sanger Genome Institute (UK) and co-first author of the study.
A big contribution to evolutionary biology
The study not only advances our understanding of mammoth evolution but also contributes to the broader field of ancient DNA research. The team developed and applied an improved molecular clock dating framework, refining how genetic data can be used to estimate the ages of specimens beyond the radiocarbon dating limit. This methodological advancement offers a powerful tool for future research on extinct and endangered species.
"These results add to our earlier work where we reported million-year-old genomes for the first time. I'm very excited that now we have genetic data from many more mammoth specimens sampled across the last million years, which helps us understand how mammoth diversity has changed through time," said senior author professor Love Dalén at Stockholm University and Centre for Paleogenetics.

data.title: Show HN: AI quiz generator from any topic or book in seconds
data.author: hakimihsan_
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI系统在生成测验和回答问题时的准确性和可靠性

不同观点：
• [the_snooze] 认为AI系统在处理低风险且有充分记录的问题时表现不佳。他举例说，在关于大学橄榄球教练变动的问题上，AI给出了错误答案，而他提供了正确的答案来源（维基百科链接）。他认为，如果AI在简单任务上出错，那么其实用性就大打折扣。
• [12907835202] 也对AI的测验生成能力持怀疑态度。他提到AI在生成关于足球经理游戏的测验时表现不佳，经常给出荒谬或错误的答案，并且在多项选择题中坚持只有一个正确答案，即使其他选项可能也是正确的。他认为AI的准确性依赖于特定主题，且需要大量人类验证和输入。
• [hakimihsan] 对反馈表示感谢，并指出他们的AI产品（Wiyomi）目前还是一个最小可行产品（MVP），需要通过用户的反馈来改进和提升。他邀请用户试用并提供更多反馈。
• [hakimihsan_] 进一步解释了Wiyomi的开发背景和功能，强调其目的是帮助用户通过生成测验来建立学习习惯，并提供跟踪进度和设置提醒等功能。

补充讨论：
• [pryelluw] 对需要注册才能试用产品表示不满，并询问是否有演示或视频介绍。
• [bananapub] 对从AI生成的测验中学习表示怀疑，认为AI生成器可能不在乎答案是否正确，从而降低了学习效果。

争议焦点：
• AI系统在生成测验和回答问题时的准确性和可靠性是主要争议点。用户对AI在这类低风险、有明确答案的任务中的表现感到失望，并质疑其整体实用性。

主要讨论点：不同场景下学习汇编语言的价值和选择

不同观点：
• [hdrz, anta40] 强调通过模拟器或特定硬件学习汇编语言的个人经历。hdrz 提到了在90年代使用PDP-11汇编的愉快体验，而 anta40 则分享了他为逆向工程学习x86汇编以及为经典游戏机开发汇编程序的乐趣。

• [microtherion] 提出了微控制器架构（如Intel 8051和AVR）的汇编语言的重要性，认为这些架构在现代调试中仍然具有实用价值。同时指出，汇编语言的阅读能力比写作能力更为重要，因为阅读能帮助开发者在高级语言之外追踪错误。

• [raphlinus] 认为选择学习哪种汇编语言是非常主观的，但特别指出ARM32在历史和技术设计上的重要性，尤其是在微控制器领域。他通过在RP2040芯片上编写HDMI视频扫描内核的亲身经历，强调了汇编语言在性能优化方面的独特优势，同时也指出了汇编语言在面对新硬件时的维护难度。

• [musicale] 认为选择学习哪种汇编语言应根据具体使用场景决定，建议根据个人兴趣和开发需求选择合适的系统。

• [bee_rider] 提出了LLVM IIR作为一种低级但具有更高可移植性的语言，是否比汇编语言更适合某些场景的问题，并询问了其性能优化的潜力。

• [jjmr] 质疑GPU汇编技能是否仍然有实际需求。

• [DeathArrow] 分享了早期学习x86汇编帮助他理解计算机工作原理的经历，暗示了学习汇编在基础教育中的价值。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点之一是哪种汇编语言最具学习价值，特别是在不同应用场景下的选择（如微控制器 vs. 现代处理器）。
- 另一个讨论点是汇编语言的可维护性和可移植性问题，特别是面对新硬件时的适应性（如 raphlinus 提到的RP2040项目）。
- 有人提出LLVM IIR作为汇编语言的替代，探讨了其作为低级编程语言的潜力和局限性。
- 对GPU汇编语言实际需求的质疑引发了对某些特定领域（如高性能计算）技能需求的讨论。

data.article_summary: Zod 4 beta 已发布，经过一年的开发，它更快、更精简，并实现了多项期待已久的新功能。为了处理 Zod 3 代码库的局限性和用户需求，Zod 4 采用了全新的架构，解决了长期存在的设计限制，并关闭了多个高投票的开放问题。基准测试显示，Zod 4 在字符串解析上快 2.6 倍，数组解析快 3 倍，对象解析快 7 倍，同时显著减少了 TypeScript 编译器的类型实例化数量。开发团队将在未来 4-6 周内继续完善，确保与库的兼容性。感谢 Clerk 通过其 OSS Fellowship 对该项目的支持。要安装 Zod 4 beta，可以使用 `pnpm upgrade zod@next` 命令。

主要讨论点：Zod库的优缺点及其在项目中的应用

不同观点：
• Rodeoclash认为，与其不断升级到新的库（如Zod、Joi等），不如专注于构建有用的功能。他们的团队正逐步将React前端替换为Phoenix + Liveview，并强调如果前端团队有纪律性，可以避免被新的流行库分心。
• machiaweliczny关注Zod的联合类型问题，询问其是否已经修复。
• move-on-by对Zod的低维护成本表示赞赏，但对重大依赖更新感到担忧。不过，他认为Zod的改进和社区热情使他愿意继续使用。
• adriancooney是Zod的忠实粉丝，认为Zod近乎完美，并对其维护者的努力表示感谢。
• _fat_santa分享了他们团队在SaaS应用中使用Zod的经验，认为Zod直观且生成TypeScript类型很有用，但不建议已经使用Yup或Joi的团队切换。

Introducing Zod 4 beta
Refer to the
Changelog
for a complete list of breaking changes.
Zod 4 is now in beta after over a year of active development. It's faster, slimmer, more
tsc
-efficient, and implements some long-requested features.
To install the beta:
pnpm upgrade zod@next
Development will continue on the
v4
branch over a 4-6 week beta period as I work with libraries to ensure day-one compatibility with the first stable release.
❤️
Huge thanks to
Clerk
, who supported my work on Zod 4 through their extremely generous
OSS Fellowship
. They were an amazing partner throughout the (much longer than anticipated!) development process.
Why a new major version?
Zod v3.0 was released in May 2021 (!). Back then Zod had 2700 stars on GitHub and 600k weekly downloads. Today it has 36.5k stars and 23M weekly downloads. After 24 minor versions, the Zod 3 codebase has hit a ceiling; the most commonly requested features and improvements require breaking changes.
Zod 4 implements all of these in one fell swoop. It uses an entirely new internal architecture that solves some long-standing design limitations, lays the groundwork for some long-requested features, and closes 9 of Zod's
10 most upvoted open issues
. With luck, it will serve as the new foundation for many more years to come.
For a scannable breakdown of what's new, see the table of contents. Click on any item to jump to that section.

data.title: Hunger shifts attention towards less healthy food options, study finds
data.author: PaulHoule
data.article_summary: 新研究发现，饥饿会使人更加关注食物的美味程度，而忽视其营养信息，从而可能导致不健康的饮食选择。该研究发表于《eLife》，通过精心设计的实验，包括选择行为、眼动追踪和计算模型，证明饥饿状态下的人在食物选择中更优先考虑美味而非健康。研究显示，尽管所有参与者都偏好美味食物，但饥饿显著增强了这一倾向。眼动追踪发现，饥饿时人们更关注食物的视觉吸引力，而较少注意营养评分（Nutri-Score）。此外，饥饿使参与者更快做出选择，并更少考虑健康信息。这表明仅提供营养标签可能不足以改善饮食决策，尤其是在饥饿状态下。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：饥饿对决策和食物选择的影响

不同观点：
• BrenBarn认为饥饿可能会使人们在决策时偏向于使用感官特征，而非认知特征。例如，人们在饥饿时更可能依赖食物的视觉属性来判断其是否适合食用，而非依赖像"NutriScores"这样的复杂工具。这可能反映出人类在进化过程中形成的"原始"需求解决方式。
• jonahx指出，睡眠不足也会影响其饮食选择，导致他吃更多且不健康的食物。
• armchairhacker表示，饥饿会使其注意力从垃圾食品和低热量健康食品转移到高热量健康食品，如坚果黄油和希腊酸奶。这可能受到意识偏见的影响，因为许多人认为蛋白质最能饱腹。
• _HMCB_对文章提出的解决方案感到困惑，认为教育并不能解决饥饿导致的非健康饮食选择问题。防止人们处于极度饥饿状态是让他们选择健康选项的关键。
• rerdavies提到研究发现饥饿的人会选择预期热量最高的食物，这看似显而易见。研究在处理美味度、健康度和预期热量之间的相关性方面存在统计上的问题。
• potato3732842认为这种现象可能有遗传基础，因为当食物匮乏时，人们会本能地渴望高热量的食物，如脂肪和糖。
• nradov开玩笑地说图片中的汉堡看起来很健康。
• metalman提到古老的建议，吃"坏"食物总比不吃好。高海拔地区的人会渴望超高脂肪饮食，这在其正常环境中可能令人反感。
• 9283409232认为这些发现并不新奇，早就有不要在饥饿时购物和免费午餐有助于提高成绩的建议。

补充讨论：
• 研究的核心发现——饥饿会影响食物选择，特别是偏向高热量食物——被多位评论者认为是显而易见的。
• 争议的焦点在于研究是否充分解释了美味度、健康度和热量之间的复杂关系，以及是否有有效的解决方案来应对饥饿对饮食选择的负面影响。
• 睡眠不足对饮食选择的影响也被提出作为一个相关因素。
• 有人提到遗传基础可能在饥饿引发的食物偏好中起到作用。
• 最后，一些评论者认为这些发现并没有提供新的洞见，早就有类似的常识性建议。

Hunger shifts attention towards less healthy food options, study finds
by Emily Packer, George Litchfield,
eLife
Credit: Unsplash/CC0 Public Domain
New research suggests that when people are hungry, they focus more on the tastiness of food and tend to ignore nutritional information, which may contribute to poor dietary decisions.
The study,
published
as a revised Reviewed Preprint in
eLife
, is described as important by the
eLife
editors. They say the well-designed experiments—including choice behavior, eye-tracking and state-of-the-art computational modeling—yield compelling evidence to support the conclusion that people who are hungry prioritize tastiness over healthiness in their food choices.
Despite existing public health initiatives, the
prevalence of obesity
has been steadily increasing in many countries. According to the World Health Organization, worldwide adult obesity has more than doubled since 1990, and adolescent obesity has quadrupled. In 2022, 2.5 billion adults were overweight, and of these, 890 million people were living with obesity—which can significantly increase the risk of developing serious health conditions, including type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular diseases and certain types of cancer.
Throughout a single day, we make several decisions about what to eat, and these choices are largely influenced by our environment. For example, it has been previously demonstrated that nutritional scores on food options can increase the likelihood of healthy choices. On the other hand, it has been shown that a hungry decision-maker is more likely to make unhealthy choices.
"A preference for energy-dense foods is likely an evolutionary adaptation to ensure survival under conditions of scarcity. However, as high-caloric food options have become more easily available and affordable, this neurobiological mechanism to reward the consumption of calorie-dense foods is likely a contributing factor to the global surge in obesity rates," says co-author Jennifer March, a Ph.D. student in the Department of Psychology and Hamburg Center of Neuroscience, University of Hamburg, Germany.
"While we know that hunger can lead to more unhealthy food choices, we set out to better understand the cognitive mechanisms underlying this, by investigating the effect of hunger on attention and valuation processes in dietary choices."
March served as the lead author of the paper alongside Sebastian Gluth, professor and Head of Cognitive Modeling & Decision Neuroscience in the Department of Psychology and Hamburg Center of Neuroscience, University of Hamburg.
March and Gluth recruited 70 adults from the University of Hamburg and surrounding area and asked them to complete a food choice experiment in both hungry and satiated states. In both conditions, participants underwent an overnight fast. In the satiated condition, they received a protein shake the next morning at the start of the study, which matched their daily caloric needs. In the hungry condition, participants underwent an overnight fast. Participants also underwent a brief survey in order to define which foods they considered tasty, and how caloric they perceived them to be.
Using eye-tracking technology, they recorded where participants focused their attention when deciding between a healthier but less tasty option, and a tastier but less healthy one. Each food was labeled with a Nutri-Score—a standardized nutritional rating. To analyze how each participant's attention affected their food choices, the team utilized an advanced decision-making model known as the multi-attribute attentional drift diffusion model.
Although all participants showed a preference for tasty over the healthier options, regardless of hunger-state, the results confirmed that hunger significantly amplified this preference. This aligns with previous research that says that hunger increases the perceived reward of calorie-dense foods. However, this work goes a step further by demonstrating that this effect is driven by visual attention patterns and the way information is weighted in the brain's decision-making process.
In the hungry condition, participants focused more on the visual appeal of food options and less on the Nutri-Score compared to the satiated condition. They also made their choice more quickly when hungry. The author's computational modeling revealed a two-fold effect: hunger increased the importance of taste in decision-making while also making participants less likely to factor in
health information
. In fact, hungry participants seemed to effectively ignore the Nutri-Score unless it was actively fixated on.

nutritional information
labels may not be sufficient to count

• armchairhacker表示，饥饿会使其注意力从垃圾食品和低热量健康食品转移到高热量健康食品，如坚果黄油和希腊酸奶。这可能受到意识偏见的影响，因为许多人认为蛋白质最能饱腹。
• _HMCB_对文章提出的解决方案感到困惑，认为教育并不能解决饥饿导致的非健康饮食选择问题。防止人们处于极度饥饿状态是让他们选择健康选项的关键。
• rerdavies提到研究发现饥饿的人会选择预期热量最高的食物，这看似显而易见。研究在处理美味度、健康度和预期热量之间的相关性方面存在统计上的问题。
• potato3732842认为这种现象可能有遗传基础，因为当食物匮乏时，人们会本能地渴望高热量的食物，如脂肪和糖。
• nradov开玩笑地说图片中的汉堡看起来很健康。
• metalman提到古老的建议，吃"坏"食物总比不吃好。高海拔地区的人会渴望超高脂肪饮食，这在其正常环境中可能令人反感。
• 9283409232认为这些发现并不新奇，早就有不要在饥饿时购物和免费午餐有助于提高成绩的建议。

补充讨论：
• 研究的核心发现——饥饿会影响食物选择，特别是偏向高热量食物——被多位评论者认为是显而易见的。
• 争议的焦点在于研究是否充分解释了美味度、健康度和热量之间的复杂关系，以及是否有有效的解决方案来应对饥饿对饮食选择的负面影响。
• 睡眠不足对饮食选择的影响也被提出作为一个相关因素。
• 有人提到遗传基础可能在饥饿引发的食物偏好中起到作用。
• 最后，一些评论者认为这些发现并没有提供新的洞见，早就有类似的常识性建议。

data.title: Battle of the Mallocators
data.author: qianli_cs
data.article_summary:
这篇文章主要讨论了在使用RocksDB时如何避免内存溢出（OOM）问题，建议使用jemalloc或tcmalloc，而不是glibc malloc。RocksDB在读取存储块时频繁进行内存分配和释放，这种模式会导致glibc malloc管理下的内存驻留集大小（RSS）过大。相比之下，jemalloc和tcmalloc能更好地处理这种分配模式，避免RSS过大。

文章通过实验比较了不同内存分配器在MyRocks（基于RocksDB的MySQL版本）和InnoDB引擎下的表现。结果显示，对于MyRocks，jemalloc和tcmalloc的峰值RSS明显小于glibc malloc，且性能（QPS）也略优。对于InnoDB，不同分配器的峰值RSS相近，性能差异不大。

此外，文章还提到jemalloc在某些版本中存在RSS过大的回归问题，但总体仍优于glibc malloc。作者建议使用jemalloc或tcmalloc来避免OOM问题，并提供了实验配置和硬件细节以供参考。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同内存分配器（allocator）在并发应用中的表现以及版本差异对性能测试的影响

不同观点：
• [dallamaneni的观点] jemalloc在高并发应用中表现更好，有大量证据支持。jemalloc曾经是Rust的默认分配器，但为了减小二进制文件大小，Rust改用了系统默认分配器。

• [fweimo的观点] 该讨论中引用的分配器版本较为陈旧（三到六年之间），而如今已经有了更新版本的tcmalloc（如来自google/tcmalloc仓库的版本），并且与gperftools中捆绑的版本不同。版本差异可能影响性能评估的准确性。

• [pajko的观点] 提供了关于内存分配器性能测试的参考链接，但没有明确表明自己的立场，更多是提供信息供其他人参考。

• [WalterGR的观点] 解释了RSS（常驻内存集大小）的定义，为讨论中的技术术语提供了背景知识，但没有直接参与性能讨论。

• [ajross的观点] 认为讨论中缺乏对测试环境和运行配置的详细记录，特别是在现代内存分配器中有许多加固和跟踪功能，可能会影响性能测试结果。强调如果只是为了百分之几的性能差异，应该更清楚地说明软件的配置，以确保比较的公平性。此外，推测glibc在典型Linux发行版中可能比其他替代分配器的默认构建更加加固，因此实际性能可能更好。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是不同内存分配器版本对性能测试结果的影响，fweimo指出了版本过时的问题。
• 另一个值得注意的点是ajross提出的测试环境透明度问题，认为需要更详细的配置说明以确保测试的准确性和可比性。
• dallamaneni提供了jemalloc在高并发情况下表现更好的证据，但ajross的怀疑态度表明，实际性能可能还受到其他因素影响，如加固功能。

43668333.article_content:
If you use RocksDB and want to avoid OOM then use jemalloc or tcmalloc and avoid glibc malloc. That was true in 2015 and remains true in 2025 (
see here
). The problem is that RocksDB can be an allocator stress test because it does an allocation (calls malloc) when a block is read from storage and then does a deallocation (calls free) on eviction. These allocations have very different lifetimes as some blocks remain cached for a long time and that leads to much larger RSS than expected when using glibc malloc. Fortunately, jemalloc and tcmalloc are better at tolerating that allocation pattern without making RSS too large.
I have yet to notice a similar problem with InnoDB, in part because it does a few large allocations at process start for the InnoDB buffer pool and it doesn't do malloc/free per block read from storage.
There was a recent claim from a MySQL performance expert, Dimitri Kravtchuk, that either RSS or VSZ can grow too large with InnoDB and jemalloc. I don't know all of the details for his setup and I failed to reproduce his result on my setup. Too be fair, I show here that VSZ for InnoDB + jemalloc can be larger than you might expect but that isn't a problem, it is just an artifact of jemalloc that can be confusing. But RSS for jemalloc with InnoDB is similar to what I get from tcmalloc.
tl;dr
For glibc malloc with MyRocks I get OOM on a server with 128G of RAM when the RocksDB buffer pool size is 50G. I might have been able to avoid OOM by using between 30G and 40G for the buffer pool. On that host I normally use jemalloc with MyRocks and a 100G buffer pool.
With respect to peak RSS
For InnoDB the peak RSS with all allocators is similar and peak RSS is ~1.06X larger than the InnoDB buffer pool.
For MyRocks the peak RSS is smallest with jemalloc, slightly larger with tcmalloc and much too large with glibc malloc. For (jemalloc, tcmalloc, glibc malloc) It was (1.22, 1.31, 3.62) times larger than the 10G MyRocks buffer pool. I suspect those ratios would be smaller for jemalloc and tcmalloc had I used an 80G buffer pool.
For performance, QPS with jemalloc and tcmalloc is slightly better than with glibc malloc
For InnoDB: [jemalloc, tcmalloc] get [2.5%, 3.5%] more QPS than glibc malloc
For MyRocks: [jemalloc, tcmalloc] get [5.1%, 3.0%] more QPS than glibc malloc
Prior art
I have several blog posts on using jemalloc with MyRocks.
October 2015
- MyRocks with glibc malloc, jemalloc and tcmalloc
April 2017
- Performance for large, concurrent allocations
April 2018
- RSS for MyRocks with jemalloc vs glibc malloc
August 2023
- RocksDB and glibc malloc
September 2023
- A regression in jemalloc 4.4.0 and 4.5.0 (too-large RSS)
September 2023
- More on the regression in jemalloc 4.4.0 and 4.5.0
October 2023
- Even more on the regression in jemalloc 4.4.0 and 4.5.0
Builds, configuration and hardware
I compiled upstream MySQL 8.0.40 from source for InnoDB. I also compiled FB MySQL 8.0.32 from source for MyRocks. For FB MySQL I used source as of October 23, 2024 at git hash ba9709c9 with RocksDB 9.7.1.
The server is an
ax162-s
from Hetzner with 48 cores (AMD EPYC 9454P), 128G RAM and AMD SMT disabled. It uses Ubuntu 22.04 and storage is ext4 with SW RAID 1 over 2 locally attached NVMe devices. More details on it
are here
. At list prices a similar server from Google Cloud costs 10X more than from Hetzner.
For malloc the server uses:
glibc
version2.35-0ubuntu3.9
tcmalloc
provided by libgoogle-perftools-dev and
apt-cache show
claims this is version 2.9.1
enabled by malloc-lib=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libtcmalloc_minimal.so in my.cnf
jemalloc
provided by libjemalloc-dev and
apt-cache show
claims this is version 5.2.1-4ubuntu1
enabled by malloc-lib=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libjemalloc.so in my.cnf
The configuration files are here
for InnoDB
and
for MyRocks
. For InnoDB I used an 80G buffer pool. I tried to use a 50G buffer pool for MyRocks but with glibc malloc there was OOM so I repeated all tests with a 10G buffer pool. I might have been able avoid OOM with MyRocks and glibc malloc by using a between 30G and 40G for MyRocks -- but I didn't want to spend more time figuring that out when the real answer is to use jemalloc or tcmalloc.
Benchmark
I used sysbench and my usage is
explained here
. To save time I only run 27 of the 42 microbenchmarks and most test only 1 type of SQL statement.
The tests run with 16 tables and 50M rows/table. There are 256 client threads and each microbenchmark runs for 1200 seconds. Normally I don't run with (client threads / cores) >> 1 but I do so here to create more stress and to copy what I think Dimitri had done.
Normally when I run sysbench I configure it so that the test tables fit in the buffer pool (block cache) but I don't do that here because I want to MyRocks to do IO as allocations per storage read create much drama for the allocator.
The command line to run all tests is:
bash r.sh 16 50000000 1200 1200 md2 1 0 256

data.title: Ask HN: How do you monetize personal code if it's not an "app"?
data.author: splimeproject
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何将小型工具或代码转化为收入

不同观点：
• [hello_newman] 认为无需创建完整的应用程序或公司，只需开发一系列解决特定痛点的小型工具或属性，例如Micro SaaS、付费API、产品化实用工具、数字捆绑包等，通过简单的前端或付费API获利。
• [averageRoyalty] 建议不要只专注于分享酷炫的东西，而要解决具体问题，即使这意味着要编写乏味但实用的代码。可以通过开源代码吸引流量，并引导至公司网站。
• [Uzmanali] 分享了个人经验，通过创建简单的着陆页和“买我一杯咖啡”链接，从一个小型CLI工具中获得了稳定的收入。
• [dhosek] 表示对开源软件的 monetization 不太在意，认为任何收入都是额外的奖励，主要关注代码的实用性和分享。
• [jedberg] 提出可以通过成立公司来销售所有工具，但指出向开发者销售很难，除非能提供显著的价值或解决企业级问题。
• [zerealshadowban] 建议通过咨询来利用专业工具和代码获利，强调基于价值的收费模式。
• [Pawamoy] 使用sponsorware策略，通过每月订阅费和资助目标来解锁更多功能，激励用户付费。
• [3np] 认为并非所有东西都需要货币化，可以将代码发布到git repo上回馈社区，同时也可以建立个人品牌。
• [miningape] 建议发布特定语言的包，如PIP包、Rust crates等，并通过单元测试提高质量。
• [splimeproject] 寻求成功将小型工具或功能货币化的例子和经验，希望通过分享想法找到创意路径。
• [muzani] 指出付费API是可行的，并讨论了在AI时代数据处理的机会，同时提到需要原型来提高竞争力。
• [PaulHoule] 提出创建“应用程序商店”式的FaaS平台，并指出过去在API经济中的产品未能解决计费和支付问题。
• [codr7] 建议将代码转化为书籍形式。
• [gdulli] 寻求一种服务或专业人士，帮助将核心代码转化为可销售的服务或应用程序。
• [mak8] 建议在CodeCanyon等平台上销售脚本。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及的工具和策略多样，包括Micro SaaS、付费API、产品化实用工具、数字捆绑包、开源代码、sponsorware策略、咨询服务、发布特定语言包等。
• 争议的焦点在于是否需要将所有代码货币化，以及如何在解决具体问题和分享酷炫东西之间找到平衡。
• 一些评论者分享了个人成功经验，提供了实际例子和建议，如简单的着陆页和“买我一杯咖啡”链接。
• 咨询和指导也被认为是将代码转化为收入的一种方式，特别是对于不愿或不能自己采取步骤的人。

data.title: New urinal designs prevent 265,000 gallons of urine splashing onto the floor
data.author: anjel
data.article_summary: 科学家提出两种新型小便池设计——"丰饶角"（Cornucopia）和"鹦鹉螺"（Nautilus），以减少公共厕所中的尿液溅回问题。目前，由于传统小便池设计，美国每天约有100万升尿液溅到地面和墙上，导致卫生问题和异味。研究团队通过流体物理模型和实验发现，当尿液以小于30度角撞击表面时，溅回显著减少。新型设计中，丰饶角表现最佳，但鹦鹉螺因其高度适合儿童和轮椅使用者，且易于清洁和维护，被认为更理想。若在美国所有5600万个小便池中采用鹦鹉螺设计，每天可减少100万升尿液溅出，并节省约1000万升清洁用水，显著提升卫生条件并降低成本。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：新型小便池设计及其在减少溅尿、提升卫生和节约资源方面的有效性和可行性

不同观点：

• ordersofmag质疑新设计能否真正减少清洁成本，指出女性洗手间的地板清洁频率与男性洗手间相似，因此节水效果可能有限。

• chasil提到指示牌可以减少清洁成本，并引用了一些幽默的洗手间标语。

• BrenBarn和pilingual分别对文章发表的期刊和以前认为已解决的问题提出评论。
• rr808和dustbunny提出了一些极端或幽默的解决方案，如使用格栅地面或设计适用于太空站的吸尘小便池。
• leoh和kevin_thibedeau分享了实际环境中遇到的特定问题，如厕所座位上的尿液和蚂蚁入侵。

• 新设计在实际应用中是否如理论和模拟中那样有效，特别是在减少溅尿和节约资源方面。

43668957.article_content:
The Nautilus and Cornucopia designs could significantly reduce urine splashback in public restrooms.
(Image credit: Thurairajah et al)
Thousands of gallons of ill-aimed pee could be spared from lavatory floors thanks to a new urinal design, scientists say.
Around 1 million liters (264,172 gallons) of urine are spilled onto the floor and walls of public restrooms each day in the U.S. thanks to current urinal shapes, creating hygiene issues and unpleasant smells.
But now, in a new study published Tuesday (April 8) in the journal
PNAS Nexus
, scientists have proposed a new urinal design that could significantly reduce this spillage — improving the hygiene of public bathrooms and reducing cleaning costs.
Urinals have not changed much since they started becoming popular in
19th-century Europe
, as part of growing public health reforms in fast-growing cities. There are now around 56 million public restrooms across the U.S. alone, the scientists said in the study.
"Urinals are a staple of public spaces yet their designs have remained essentially stagnant for over a century,” the researchers wrote in the study. "The use of urinals often results in significant splatter (splashback) as urine splashes upon impact with the urinal generating droplets which travel back onto the floor and user."
This splashback is a breeding ground for bacteria, resulting in bad smells in public restrooms and the potential for the spread of diseases.
Related:
The Physics of Peeing, and How to Avoid Splash-Back
Sign up for the Live Science daily newsletter now
Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
Contact me with news and offers from other Future brands
Receive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors
"The surfaces of urinals have significantly higher concentrations of bacteria than traditional toilets, with surrounding floors having the highest level," the researchers added.
This high level of spillage of urine requires frequent cleaning, which uses a large volume of water, is unpleasant work for custodial staff and is very expensive.
Some bathrooms attempt to reduce splashback using urinal screens, mats, or even stickers to tell people where to aim their urine. The
use of such stickers
at Amsterdam’s Schiphol airport was found to reduce splashback by between 50 and 80% and lower cleaning costs by 8%.
New urinal designs are making a splash
To resolve these problems, the team created a fluid physics model of how a stream of liquid splashes when it hits a surface like the back of a urinal, and experimentally tested these models by spraying liquid at surfaces at various angles.
They mimicked a stream of urine by creating a "pseudo-urethra nozzle," which had the same internal geometry as a human urethra, and used dyed liquid to better determine where splashback was occurring.
They found that when the urine stream hit the surface at less than 30 degrees, the level of splashback was reduced to only 1.4% of the levels seen in a traditional urinal design.
They used these models to design
two new urinal shapes
, which they dubbed Cornucopia and Nautilus. The Cornucopia somewhat resembles a public trash can, while the Nautilus wouldn't look out of place in an avant-garde furniture store.
The researchers' Cornucopia and Nautilus designs both achieved a significant reduction in urine splashing, with the Cornucopia performing best. However, the Nautilus was considered the most ideal design due to its height, which would allow shorter people — including children or those in wheelchairs — to more easily use it. Its larger gape would also be easier to clean, and would be more accepting of poor aim, and therefore would also be appropriate for use on boats or airplanes.
RELATED STORIES
—
A new, ridiculously slippery toilet bowl could keep poop from sticking, scientists report
—
In a first, breakthrough 3D holograms can be touched, grabbed and poked
—
Quantum computing breakthrough could make 'noise' — forces that disrupt calculations — a thing of the past
The researchers suggest that if Nautilus was to replace the 56 million urinals across the U.S., around 1 million liters of urine would be prevented from being splashed onto the floor every day. Assuming that the volume of water needed to clean up spilled urine is about 10 times that of the volume of urine, about 10 million liters (2,199,692 gallons) of fresh water could be saved every day, the scientists said.
The widespread adoption of these urinal designs "would result in considerable conservation of human resources, cost, cleaning chemicals, and water usage, rendering large-scale impacts on modern society by improving sustainability, hygiene, and accessibility," the researchers wrote.
TOPICS

data.title: Minestom – An open-source, lightweight Minecraft server built from the ground up
data.author: Tmpod
data.article_summary: Minestom 是一个轻量级的服务器软件，具有 minimal（最少）的功能，这使得它更加高效，并允许用户根据需要轻松扩展其功能。这种设计使得 Minestom 更加灵活，适用于需要自定义和优化的 Minecraft 服务器环境。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Minestom项目的编程语言选择、目标受众及其与其它Minecraft服务器软件（如Fabric或Paper）的区别。

不同观点：
• [Daviey] 认为该项目使用Java开发不太理想，个人更希望使用Rust或Golang，因为这些语言在性能和并发处理上可能有优势。不过他也承认项目整体看起来不错，尤其赞赏了README中包含示例演示及优缺点的对比。
• [Tmpod] 解释了Minestom的定位，指出它是一个开放源代码库，目标用户是开发非官方Minecraft服务器软件的开发者，特别适用于创建小游戏、PvP对战等非生存类玩法的服务器。他强调Minestom不包含任何默认功能，但提供了一个强大的API，允许开发者实现各种自定义功能，且明确指出它并非面向终端用户，而是面向开发者。
• [BrawnyBadger53] 提出了Minestom与已有Minecraft服务器软件（如Fabric或Paper）的区别问题，并询问了红石机制是否与原版Minecraft一致。这显示出用户在选择不同服务器开发工具时的困惑，特别是关于功能实现的细节。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是编程语言的选择。Daviey对Java的偏好提出质疑，认为Rust或Golang可能更合适，但Tmpod并没有直接回应这一问题，而是转向解释项目的功能与受众。
• Minestom的目标受众是开发者而非终端用户，这一点在Tmpod的评论中得到了澄清。
• BrawnyBadger53提出的红石机制问题揭示了在自定义服务器开发中，对原版游戏机制保留与修改的实际需求，这是一个实际应用中的重要技术问题。

data.title: I ditched my laptop for a pocketable mini PC and a pair of AR glasses
data.author: T-A
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了作者如何通过结合迷你PC、AR眼镜和移动电源，打造出一套便携的移动工作环境。作者曾依赖多屏桌面设置工作，外出时尝试用笔记本但仍需额外配件。最终，作者选择了Khadas Mind迷你PC，其小巧便携，采用USB-C供电，并具备多种端口和视频输出功能。搭配Xreal One AR眼镜，作者实现了从标准到超宽显示的切换。此外，大容量移动电源确保了长时间工作。这套组合让作者可以在任何地方高效工作，如同在家中一样。Khadas Mind 2S作为升级版，配备更强处理器和存储，进一步提升了体验。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AR/VR眼镜替代传统屏幕作为生产力工具的可行性

不同观点：
• **[raffraffraff]** 认为Viture Pro XR眼镜在Linux系统上支持不佳，尤其缺乏头部追踪功能，且Android应用限制较多，仅支持特定应用如YouTube，不适用于生产力场景。他表示可能Xreal眼镜会是更好的选择。
• **[Abishek_Muthian]** 强调AR眼镜在提高可访问性方面的潜力，特别是在行动不便的情况下（如术后恢复），可以提供便携的低延迟显示设备，改善生活质量。
• **[sathackr]** 分享了使用Xreal One和Minisforum UM790的体验，认为1920x1080的分辨率虽然清晰但不够锐利，特别是在习惯了高分辨率屏幕后，边缘模糊问题明显。他指出，尽管有不足，但在某些场景下眼镜的灵活性仍然有用。
• **[danielEM]** 对Nreal Air眼镜的长时间佩戴体验持否定态度，认为其佩戴不适，不适合替代常规屏幕。
• **[jareds]** 是一位盲人用户，指出对于不需要屏幕的用户来说，AR/VR眼镜可能有节能和便携的优势，但当前的键盘和设置仍有改进空间。
• **[ikurei]** 对在公共场合使用AR眼镜持怀疑态度，认为在安全性和社交方面存在问题，尤其是在咖啡店等环境下。他还质疑是否真的有人能完全放弃传统笔记本电脑。
• **[1dom]** 长期使用头戴显示设备，认为早期设备如Fresnel镜头存在问题，但较新的设备如Quest Pro表现更好。他指出在虚拟现实中使用大屏幕工作的优缺点，并批评了一些相关公司的不当经营策略。
• **[mrbonner]** 对Xreal眼镜的观影体验表示认可，但认为由于字体模糊和小尺寸，不适合全职工作使用。
• **[nicbou]** 和 **[tippytippytango]** 都提到在公共场合使用AR眼镜让他们感到不适和尴尬，且1080p的分辨率在习惯了高分辨率显示后显得不足。
• **[herpdyderp]** 对VR头显作为虚拟桌面屏幕的实用性表示关注，特别提到Bigscreen Beyond 2的轻量和便携性，但质疑其是否适合工作场景。
• **[Mortiffer]** 怀疑此类评论是 sponsored content（ sponsored 内容），因为大多数用户最终因文字清晰度、眼疲劳和键盘设置问题回归传统笔记本电脑。
• **[supermatt]** 对Xreal眼镜的3DoF（三自由度）功能表示怀疑，认为其在实际使用中可能不如宣传视频所示，且缺乏足够的信息和真实评测。
• **[seltzered_]** 提到Reddit上的ErgoMobileComputers社区对Xreal眼镜有讨论，认为虽然不是他的首选，但对有特殊人体工学需求的用户可能有吸引力。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：AR/VR眼镜在分辨率、舒适度、操作系统兼容性和使用场景上的局限性是主要争议点。一部分用户认为这些设备尚不足以替代传统屏幕，而另一部分用户则看到了其在特定场景下的潜力，如行动不便者的辅助工具或个人娱乐设备。
• **技术细节**：一些用户如supermatt对眼镜的技术细节（如输入分辨率、头部追踪功能）提出质疑，认为市场上缺乏足够的透明信息和真实评测。
• **人体工学**：一些用户如kelvie指出AR眼镜在改善姿势和减少肌肉疲劳方面的优势，特别是在需要长时间使用电脑的场景下。

I work best seated at my
desk setup
with multiple screens in front of me However, when I travel or just need to get out of the house for a bit, I can’t bring my setup with me—or at least I thought I couldn’t.
Now I know what you’re thinking. Why don’t I just go with one of the
best laptops
instead? Well, I’ve tried and while my
trusty ThinkPad
hasn’t let me down yet, I still end up using it with extra peripherals and oftentimes, a
portable monitor
too, which kind of defeats the purpose of using a laptop in the first place.
Over the past few years, I’ve also downsized from a full desktop and I now do the majority of my work from one of the
best mini PCs
. I like the experience of using a mini PC over a desktop or a laptop so much that I even
took a mini PC with me to Taiwan
last summer.

I built a completely distraction-free desk setup with these 10 gadgets — and now I’m truly locked in
I built a completely distraction-free desk setup — and now I’m truly locked in
Of all the mini PCs I’ve tested and reviewed, one in particular has stuck with me and that’s due to how portable it is and the fact that it uses a USB-C port for power instead of a barrel port connector. After trying out a pair of AR glasses for the first time when I
spent two weeks with the iPad mini
, I decided why not combine the two together and throw one of the
best power banks
into the mix for good measure. Then, I could truly work from anywhere just like I do from the comfort of my home office.
I’ve been using a pocketable mini PC, a pair of AR glasses and a massive 25,000 mAh power bank together for the past two weeks and it’s completely transformed the way I work. Here’s how I came up with this novel approach to on-the-go computing to better fit my unique workflow.
Pocketable meets private
(Image credit: Tom's Guide)
Last year, I got to try out the
Khadas Mind
and even now, there’s no mini PC quite like it. Instead of being rectangular or having a cube-like shape, the Mind looks a lot more like one of the
best external hard drives
. Not only is it powerful, it’s also pocketable thanks to its tiny 5.75 x 4.13 x 0.79-inch frame.
Another thing that sets the Khadas Mind apart from other mini PCs is that Khadas has created a whole ecosystem of accessories around it. There’s the standard Mind Dock which adds more ports, dual-monitor support, a fingerprint reader and even a volume knob on the side, as well as the premium Mind Graphics dock which adds even more ports as well as a full-size Nvidia RTX 4060 Ti desktop graphics card.
Khadas is also working on a portable display with a keyboard that magnetically attaches to this mini PC like both of these docks do if you prefer a more laptop-like experience.
(Image credit: Tom's Guide)
The main reason I chose the Khadas Mind for this project is because of its ports and portability though. Like I said before, it uses a USB-C port for power (on the far left) but it also has a second, full-featured USB-C port for video out in addition to two USB-A ports and an HDMI port. With one USB-C port for power and another for video, the Khadas Mind turned out to be the perfect fit for this one-of-a-kind mobile setup.
After I reviewed the original Mind last year, Khadas unveiled the Mind 2S at
CES
back in January as a more powerful followup to the Mind 2. I had already sent the Mind 1 back, so I reached out to Khadas directly and they sent over this new more powerful mini PC for this project, though I am working on a review of it too.
While the Mind 1 handled everything I threw at quite well, the Mind 2S is an absolute powerhouse with an Intel Core Ultra 7 255H processor, 64GB of LPDDR5X RAM and a 2TB SSD. Khadas also upgraded its two USB-C ports to Thunderbolt 4 ones for faster data transfer speeds and enhanced display capabilities.

This pocketable and modular mini PC packs a ton of power into a tiny package. The Mind 2S is powered by an Intel Core Ultra 7 255 H processor, comes with 64GB of LPDDR5X RAM and has a 2TB SSD. best smart glasses yet

data.title: Levels of configuration languages
data.author: kaycebasques
data.article_summary:
本文讨论了配置语言的五个层次，从简单到复杂，探讨了各自的特点和使用场景。

1. **Level 1：文件中的字符串**  
   最简单的键值对形式，如Linux的`/proc`文件系统。

2. **Level 2：列表**  
   文件内容为列表或键值对列表，如INI文件，支持更多表达能力，但不能嵌套。

3. **Level 3：嵌套数据结构**  
   使用JSON、YAML、XML等格式，支持复杂嵌套结构，但缺乏计算能力。

4. **Level 4：全功能编程语言（非图灵完备）**  
   支持计算但保证终止，如XSLT、Jsonnet、Dhall，工具支持较少。

5. **Level 5：完整编程语言**  
   使用Python、JavaScript等图灵完备语言，灵活但可能导致配置与代码间的循环依赖问题。

选择配置语言的原则是尽量使用较低层次以保持简单，但预测未来的需求往往困难。在同一层次内争论优劣并无太大意义。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：配置语言的层次和选择

不同观点：
• **支持使用TypeScript等高级配置工具**：retropragma认为使用像unconfig和bundle-require这样的工具可以支持JSON、JavaScript，尤其是TypeScript配置，提供了很大的灵活性。
• **文件存在作为配置模式**：susam提到一种基于文件存在性的配置模式，文件本身通常为空，通过文件的存在与否来决定软件行为，这是一种非常简单的配置方式。
• **Terraform/HCL作为Level 4配置语言的争议**：alexambarch认为Terraform/HCL在复杂场景下显得不足，倾向于直接跳到Level 5语言。
• **"total"与"turing-complete"的区别**：ks2048质疑"total"和"turing-complete"之间的巨大区别，并通过示例说明即使是可以终止的程序也可能导致配置文件挂起。
• **Level 4.5的提议**：jiggawatts提出在结构化模板和完全程序化脚本之间存在"Level 4.5"，例如Pulumi，它结合了全部功能和安全性。
• **YAML与JSON的争议**：
  - 18172828286177认为YAML比JSON更容易使用，值得坚持使用。
  - sgeisenh则认为YAML有太多陷阱，推荐使用JSON或TOML。
• **对配置语言单一维度分类的质疑**：ajb认为不能仅通过一个维度来区分配置语言，表达能力和验证能力是相对独立的。
• **XML的优缺点**：ks2048和chewbacha提到XML虽然不如YAML流行，但有更好的工具支持且避免了一些JSON和YAML的问题。
• **SQL作为配置语言的潜力**：bob1029认为SQL可以作为Level 4/5配置语言，具体取决于SQL方言和使用方式。
• **不同配置语言分类法的比较**：chubot提到自己对配置语言的分类方法，并认为"Total"编程语言的概念并不实用，更关注语言的执行速度和无I/O特性。

补充讨论：
• **配置复杂性的循环**：rdtsc指出，复杂配置系统往往会从Level 4或5回退到Level 2或3，形成一种循环。
• **具体工具推荐**：waynecochran提到Jsonnet作为增强版JSON工具，throw0101d则偏好ISC BIND使用的配置风格，认为其介于INI和更结构化的Level 3之间。

争议焦点：
• YAML与JSON的优劣比较，以及如何选择合适的配置语言。
• Level 4配置语言（如Terraform/HCL）是否足够应对复杂场景，是否应直接跳到Level 5。
• "Total"编程语言与"Turing-complete"编程语言的实际区别及其在配置中的应用。

43667494.article_content:
Code is data and data is code.
Years ago, I had a brief affair with Lisp
and there I picked up this meme.
Today, I believe there are also benefits in separating code and data.
Glimpses of this debate come up
whenever people discuss the syntax for yet another configuration schema.
There are 5 levels of power for configuration languages.
If you design a new schema,
be aware of all of them.
Level 1: String in a File
The file system is a key-value store.
The Linux kernel does it with
procfs
and
sysfs
.
Example from my shell:
$ cat /proc/sys/kernel/arch
x86_64
$ cat /proc/sys/kernel/sched_energy_aware
1
I could write
0
to the second one to change the kernel behavior.
This certainly is the simplest format, yet it works.
Level 2: A List
For a little bit more expressive power,
you can treat the file contents as a list.
Maybe one per line.
Maybe a key-plus-value per line.
Maybe with sections like an
INI file
.
Example file contents:
[database]
server = 192.0.2.62
port = 143
file = "payroll.dat"
This is already complex enough that not everything is intuitive.
What happens if you duplicate a key?
Can you do multiline strings?
The defining constraint is that you cannot have a list of lists.
That would be the next level.
However, think twice before going there
because with a little pre- and postfixing names,
you can do a lot here.
Level 3: Nested Data Structures
This is probably the most popular level,
where we find JSON, YAML, XML, TOML, etc.
Example file contents:
{
"database": {
"host": "localhost",
"port": 1234,
"auth": {
"user": "elon",
"password": "mars2023"
}
}
}
It is fascinating how much people can discuss about the pros and cons
of the alternatives on this level even though they are more or less the same.
I actually like XML.
It isn't "cool" like YAML anymore,
but it has better tooling support (e.g. schema checking)
and doesn't try to be
too clever
.
Just try to stay away from namespaces and don't be afraid of using attributes.
In practice,
many later encounter the limitation that you cannot compute anything.
Maybe they need
variables
or want to
generate
a list of things.
Then they retrofit it with abominations like "Python-expressions as values"
or "Jinja-templates for generation".
At this point, you better get up another level
and this is where we transition from data to code, don't you think?
Level 4: Total Programming Languages
This is the least known level and should probably be more popular.
The term
total functional programming
means you can compute stuff,
but it will terminate.
This is explicitly
not
Turing-complete.
This level includes
XSLT
,
Jsonnet
(a JSON extension),
and even typed ones like
Dhall
.
Here is a
Starlark
example from Bazel:
java_binary(
name = "ProjectRunner",
srcs = glob(["src/main/java/com/example/*.java"]),
)
A challenge here is that you are programming,
but since the languages are not that popular,
you don't have the usual language tooling available.
So, the final level...
Level 5: Full Programming Language
Of course, you can use any scripting language to configure things.
Python, Javascript, Lua, TCL, whatever.
They are Turing-complete.
For example,
Conan
is a package manager where you specify packages in Python:
from conan import ConanFile
class CompressorRecipe(ConanFile):
settings = "os", "compiler", "build_type", "arch"
generators = "CMakeToolchain", "CMakeDeps"
def requirements(self):
self.requires("zlib/1.2.11")
def build_requirements(self):
self.tool_requires("cmake/3.22.6")
Any Python programmer can easily add complex logic where they see fit.
Often people discover the problem,
that the configuration determines
what
to import,
but the imports also determine the configuration itself.
This circular dependency leads to madness.
For example,
in Conan you declare dependencies like in the example above.
You might want to depend on some Python module
which you use in this script.
At that point you are already executing the script though.
Thus, Conan invented
python_requires_extend
,
its own weird way to inject a super-class into an existing object.
How to avoid this madness?
Introduce another low-level configuration file.
Back to level one...
Which Level to Use?
The guiding principles is to
use the lowest possible level
to keep it simple.
Unfortunately, it usually is not an easy decision
because you don't know the future.
The corollary of my level structure:
Don't waste time on discussions
within
a level.
For example, JSON and YAML both have their problems and pitfalls
but both are probably good enough.
Discussion on lobste.rs
with great comments.
Â©
2025-04-12

data.title: Royal Mail trials solar-powered postboxes with barcode scanners
data.author: OJFord
data.article_summary: 皇家邮政推出了一款由太阳能驱动并配备条码扫描器的新型邮筒，旨在方便顾客投递包裹。这款邮筒拥有更大的投递口，顾客扫描包裹条码后，邮筒的抽屉会自动打开。该设计是邮筒自175年前引入以来的最大变化，目前正在英国的Ware、Hertford和Fowlmere地区试运行。若试验成功，皇家邮政计划在全英国推广。此举旨在应对信件量下降和包裹量增加的趋势，提升邮筒的利用率。同时，皇家邮政的应用程序也已更新，支持顾客通过4G和定位服务获取投递证明。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：皇家邮政的创新措施及其相关技术、服务改进建议

不同观点：
• **[londons_explore]** 认为皇家邮政缺乏创新，并提出了几项具体改进建议，包括让收件人付费加快递送速度、将信件自动转换为电子邮件、提供高级快速递送服务、允许发件人稍后选择收件地址以及提供包装服务。这些建议旨在提升用户体验并增加服务灵活性。
• **[PaulKeeble]** 对邮筒上的太阳能板设计进行了技术分析，认为这是一种成本和难度相对较低的解决方案。他讨论了太阳能板的输出功率和在英国气候条件下的实际效能，并提出了通过定制硬件和软件优化能耗的工程解决方案，以应对冬季低功率的问题。
• **[srmarm]** 提到皇家邮政App上已有类似的功能，如允许通过邮筒进行投递证明，并指出这项功能可以节省用户前往邮局的麻烦，同时降低邮政运营成本。
• **[cogman10]** 对邮筒传感器的防破坏性表示担忧，建议将传感器嵌入邮筒内部以减少破坏风险。他还质疑这项技术相比于让邮递员使用扫描枪或手机的实用性，认为后者可能更有效。
• **[xattt]** 关注实际使用中的物理限制问题，指出文章图片中显示的邮筒投递口与包裹尺寸不匹配，质疑用户是否能顺利投递包裹。
• **[tdeck]** 对比了美国的情况，指出美国邮筒逐渐改装后只能投递薄信封，无法投递小包裹，表达了对这种设计的不满，并暗示英国邮筒设计的相对便利性。

补充讨论：
• 技术创新与实用性之间的平衡：[PaulKeeble] 和 [cogman10] 都关注了技术方案的可行性和实用性，提出了关于能耗和设备物理保护的讨论。
• 服务改进的优先级：[londons_explore] 的建议集中在用户体验和服务灵活性上，而 [srmarm] 则关注现有功能的实际应用和成本节约。
• 国际对比：[tdeck] 提供了美国邮筒设计的反例，突显了英国设计在某些方面的优越性。

争议焦点：
• 太阳能邮筒传感器的实用性与防破坏性：[cogman10] 对传感器的外置设计提出质疑，认为存在被破坏的风险，建议使用更隐蔽的设计。
• 太阳能技术在冬季低能效问题：[PaulKeeble] 指出太阳能板在冬季输出功率低，可能影响设备正常运行，需要定制硬件和软件以优化能耗。

这些观点和讨论反映了不同用户对皇家邮政创新措施的多角度审视，包括技术可行性、用户体验、实际应用中的物理限制和国际对比。

Royal Mail trials solar-powered postboxes with barcode scanners
Open-access content
Jack Loughran
—
Thu 10 Apr 2025
Royal Mail
Royal Mail has unveiled a solar-powered postbox equipped with a barcode reader designed to make it easier for customers to drop off their parcels.
The firm said the new design is “the biggest change to postbox design since their introduction more than 175 years ago”.
The iconic postbox design has broadly stayed the same, but has been given an extra-large opening to accept parcels larger than those that fit through a letterbox. Customers can then scan their parcel’s barcode and a drawer opens for them to drop it in. They can also request proof of posting using the Royal Mail app.
Five of the new postboxes are being piloted in the Ware, Hertford and Fowlmere areas before Royal Mail rolls them out further across the UK. Letters can still be posted in the usual way through a separate opening.
Royal Mail
The new postboxes are designed to cater to online marketplace vendors for selling second-hand goods as well as traditional online shoppers sending returns.
Royal Mail has recently updated its app so customers can post small, barcoded parcels in a postbox and request proof of posting. The app update utilises 4G and the phone’s location services for the service.
The move is part of Royal Mail’s drive to make it easier for customers to use postboxes to send parcels. There are 115,000 postboxes in the UK, located within half a mile of 98% of addresses, that currently accept parcels small enough to fit through a letterbox. But the firm said it could adapt thousands to the new design to accept larger parcels.
Royal Mail
Emma Gilthorpe, CEO at Royal Mail, said: “In making this historic change to our postboxes, our goal is to maximise choice and convenience for our customers. In an era where letter volumes continue to decline and parcels are booming, we are giving our iconic postboxes a new lease of life on street corners across the nation.
“You can now drop your parcel in any postbox where it fits – you just need a label with a barcode.”
After a successful trial period in Jersey and Guernsey, the first pillar boxes appeared in Britain in 1853. These early letter boxes were not standardised, because design, manufacture and installation was largely the responsibility of local surveyors.
By 1859, all pillar boxes were standardised in two sizes, a larger size for high-volume areas and narrower for elsewhere, with a cylindrical shape, painted green.

data.title: P2Panda: Building blocks for peer-to-peer applications
data.author: jdbohrman
data.article_summary: p2panda是一个模块化框架，旨在构建注重隐私和安全的现代本地优先应用。它采用灵活的模块设计，兼容多种数据类型和CRDT，支持移动和桌面应用开发，避免框架锁定。通过使用如BLAKE3、Ed25519、QUIC等标准和技术，p2panda确保在离线和不稳定连接下仍能进行协作、加密和访问控制。项目包括多个库，如p2panda-net（网络发现）、p2panda-sync（数据同步）、p2panda-blobs（文件传输）等，并积极研究分布式数据类型。未来项目包括Aardvark文本编辑器和Toolkitty协调工具。社区参与和开源是p2panda的重要组成部分。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：P2P和去中心化工具的兴起，以及与加密货币的关系

不同观点：
• [支持去中心化工具，但反对过度依赖加密货币]  
一些用户，如jdbohrman，对P2P和去中心化工具的兴起表示欢迎，但他们认为这些工具不应过度依赖加密货币。他们认为加密货币领域存在"脑残"（brainrot）现象，即过度炒作和不理性的投资行为，这可能影响去中心化工具的实际应用和发展。

• [认为加密货币与去中心化工具密不可分]  
另一部分用户认为，加密货币与去中心化工具是密不可分的。他们指出，区块链技术和加密货币是去中心化工具的核心驱动力，尤其是涉及到经济激励和去信任化机制。例如，用户[bobbylox]提到，加密货币提供了去中心化系统中的激励层，使得这些工具能够自我维持和发展。

• [关注去中心化工具的实际应用和用户体验]  
还有一些用户更关注去中心化工具的实际应用和用户体验。他们认为，无论是依赖加密货币与否，工具的易用性和实际解决问题的能力才是关键。用户[techie123]指出，去中心化工具需要更好的用户界面和更广泛的应用场景，才能真正被大众接受。

补充讨论：
• [对"brainrot"一词的争议]  
部分用户对"brainrot"一词的使用表示不满，认为这是一种对加密货币社区的不公平贬低。用户[cryptolover]指出，虽然加密货币领域存在投机和炒作，但也有很多创新和实际应用，不应一概而论。

• [去中心化工具的安全性和隐私问题]  
有用户提出，去中心化工具的安全性和隐私保护问题值得关注。用户[privacyadvocate]提到，虽然去中心化工具可以避免中心化机构的控制，但如果安全措施不到位，可能会导致用户数据泄露和滥用。

• [去中心化工具的可持续性]  
还有用户讨论了去中心化工具的可持续性问题。他们担心如果没有经济激励（如加密货币），这些工具的开发和维护可能难以为继。用户[sustaindev]建议，寻找其他形式的激励机制，可能是确保去中心化工具长期发展的关键。

43668661.article_content:
About
p2panda aims to provide everything you need to build
modern, privacy-respecting and secure local-first applications.
We have adopted a
modular approach
—allowing projects the freedom to pick what they need and integrate it with minimal friction. We believe this approach contributes the most to a wider, interoperable p2p ecosystem which outlives “framework lock-in”.
Many of our Rust crates operate over raw bytes and are
fully compatible with your own data types and any CRDT
. In case you don't plan on building your own peer-to-peer protocol, we have you covered with
all features required to build a mobile or desktop application
.
We're using
existing libraries
like
iroh
and well-established standards such as BLAKE3, Ed25519, STUN, CBOR, TLS, QUIC,
UCAN
,
Double Ratchet
and more - as long as they give us the radical offline-first guarantee we need.
We want collaboration, encryption and access-control to work even when operating over unstable or ephemeral connections. Towards this end, we're
actively working alongside researchers to design and implement resilient solutions
.
p2panda is "broadcast-only" at it’s heart, making any data not only offline-first but also
compatible with post-internet communication infrastructure
, such as shortwave, packet radio, Bluetooth Low Energy, LoRa or simply a USB stick.
p2panda is a very
multifaceted project
: We maintain our crates, apply for grants, design protocols and do research in radically distributed data-types. We organise community events and write peer-to-peer applications with our friends and collaborators.
Libraries
📦 p2panda-net
Find peers in a peer-to-peer network, connect to them directly - whereever they are - and exchange any data of your interest in form of byte streams.
📦 p2panda-discovery
Solutions to find other peers in your local network or on the internet and interfaces to start building your own.
📦 p2panda-sync
Protocol implementations to efficiently "catch up on past state" with other peers and interfaces to start building your own.
📦 p2panda-blobs
Efficiently send, receive and store (very large) files.
📦 p2panda-core
Highly extensible data-types of the p2panda protocol for secure, distributed and efficient exchange of data, supporting networks from the internet to packet radio, LoRa or BLE.
📦 p2panda-store
Interfaces and implementations to store p2panda data types in databases, memory or file-systems.
📦 p2panda-stream
Collection of various methods to process your p2panda data streams before they reach your application.
🚧 p2panda-node
All-in-one p2panda node which can be used in federated or fully decentralised networks or both at the same time. Supports "lightweight" clients running in the browser.
🚧 p2panda-caps
Manage access to data with capabilities.
🚧 p2panda-group
Local-first roles and group-encryption with Post-Compromise-Security and optional Forward-Secrecy.
News
✉️ Event Streams and Persistence (0.3.0)
11.03.25 ~ Bootstrap your network and listen to events
✉️ Local-First group- and message encryption in p2panda
24.02.25 ~ Insights, learnings and design from our research and implementation
✉️ Anti-Fragile Panda (0.2.0)
20.01.25 ~ Now with full offline-first networking support
✉️ 2024 Updates and Our New Release!
06.12.24 ~ So much has happened this year and we're so excited to finally tell you about it!
Projects
📝 Aardvark (coming mid-2025)
Local-first, collaborative text editor, based on GTK and Automerge.
This is a collaboration with friends from GNOME and part of a general research to explore local-first code, UI and UX patterns in GTK applications.
📢 Toolkitty (coming mid-2025)
Autonomous coordination toolkit for collectives, organisers and places to share resources and organise events in a shared calendar.
Toolkitty is built for iOS, Android and Desktop with Tauri.
🐝 Meli Bees App
Collaborative Android app for sighting and categorisation of Meliponini bee species in the Brazilian Amazon.
This project is a collaboration between p2panda and Meli and built with Flutter and aquadoggo.
📡 rhio
rhio is a peer-to-peer message router and file sync solution allowing processes to rapidly exchange messages and efficiently replicate large files without any centralised coordination.
rhio was built in collaboration with HIRO.
🐬 aquadoggo
aquadoggo is a node implementation based on an earlier version of p2panda. It is a intended as a tool for making the design and build of local-first, collaborative p2p applications as simple as possible, and hopefully even a little fun!
Contact
Find all source code on
GitHub
, follow us on the
Fediverse
, join our official
Chat
or write us an
Email
! We'd love to hear from you!

data.title: OmniSVG
data.author: handfuloflight
data.article_summary: OmniSVG是首个利用预训练视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的端到端多模态SVG生成器家族，能够生成从简单图标到复杂动漫角色的详细SVG图像。该项目于2025年4月发布，包含MMSVG-Icon和MMSVG-Illustration数据集，并提供了代码和预训练模型。其技术报告和论文可在arXiv上查阅，使用MIT许可证。主要贡献者包括Yiying Yang等。该模型借鉴了IconShop和LLM4SVG等开源工作，提升了SVG生成的精度和复杂度。项目在GitHub上有912颗星和17个分支。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于一个机器学习项目是否为有价值的项目及其代码发布延迟的讨论。

• 质疑代码发布延迟：[mubou] 对项目代码发布延迟表示疑问，指出虽然项目细节在 https://omnisvg.github.io 有更多介绍，但实际运行代码的发布被推迟，令人不解。

补充讨论：
• 项目质量：评论中对项目质量给予了较高评价，认为其在众多AI相关内容中显得独特且有价值。
• 代码发布的潜在原因：虽然未展开详细讨论，但对代码发布延迟提出了可能的关注，如项目完善度、技术问题或策略性发布等。

data.title: Adobe deletes Bluesky posts after backlash
data.author: bookofjoe
data.article_summary: Adobe's attempt to engage with users on the Bluesky platform quickly backfired due to user backlash. After introducing itself with an innocuous post, Adobe faced criticism, particularly regarding its subscription model and support for AI-generated art. Users flooded the posts with complaints, leading Adobe to delete its content. The negative reaction stems from Adobe's shift to subscription pricing over a decade ago, subsequent price hikes, and its embrace of AI, which have frustrated the creative community. Despite leaving its account active, Adobe removed its initial posts, which users found amusing. The incident highlights Adobe's strained relationship with photographers and creators.
data.comments_summary:

不同观点：

• 另一部分用户如[adzm]则肯定Adobe在AI功能和产品质量上的表现，尤其是Photoshop的AI功能，尽管他们也希望有更多竞争产品出现。
• [hliyan]和[bobjordan]对Adobe的产品有复杂的情感，一方面认可其产品质量，另一方面不满其高昂的订阅费用和商业模式。
• [simonw]和[jeffwask]对Adobe在社交媒体上的表现持批评态度，认为其发布的信息缺乏真诚，且其软件许可条款严苛。
• [delfugal]强烈反对Adobe的订阅政策，称之为“数字勒索”，因为用户一旦停止付费，将无法访问之前的工作成果。
• [nashashmi]认为公司不应在社交媒体上进行广告和互动，除非它们是社交性质的公司，否则会损害社交媒体的健康互动。

• 一些用户如[Crosseye_Jack]认为尽管可以批评Adobe，但鼓励公司在更多平台上与用户互动是有价值的，尤其是在获取客户服务方面。
• 关于Adobe商业模式的讨论中，[hliyan]提出了更广泛的利润最大化理论，即企业最终会将产品服务化并通过额外收费来增加利润。

43653885.article_content:
Adobe’s foray into the
Twitter alternative Bluesky
quickly backfired. Frustrated by the company’s business practices, users on the platform flooded its posts with backlash, ultimately prompting Adobe to delete all of its content.
“Hey, we’re Adobe! We’re here to connect with the artists, designers, and storytellers who bring ideas to life,” read Adobe’s first post which has since been deleted. “What’s fueling your creativity right now?”
It was an innocuous enough post that Adobe sent out on Tuesday (April 8) but as
Futurism
reports
, it provoked the ire of Bluesky users who immediately began airing their grievances at the company.
Adobe’s first post on Bluesky which received attention for all the wrong reasons.
“I assume you’ll be charging us monthly to read your posts,”
one user wrote
in reference to Adobe’s subscription model.
On the same day, Adobe
set up a Bluesky account for Photoshop
. That too was bombarded with negative comments.
“Go back to the fascist-owned site where they enjoy supporting AI-generated art like your brand does,” wrote Evlyn Moreau.
“Y’all keep raising your prices for a product that keeps getting worse,” wrote another user.
As of today (Thursday), both Adobe and the Photoshop accounts remain on Bluesky but both of their opening posts have been removed. Something that Bluesky users rejoiced in.
“Adobe deleting their first BlueSky post because they realize that the artist community pretty much universally hates them now is extremely funny,”
writes Betsy Bauer.
“Adobe just deleted their post with 1.6k angry comments from artists and creators roasting them,”
adds Tokori.
Adobe situation was pretty funny
[image or embed]
— BlueSpark (
@bluespark777.bsky.social
)
9 April 2025 at 04:15
Why Are People Hating On Adobe?
Adobe’s unpopularity can be traced back to a decision it made over 10 years ago when it shifted from perpetual software licensing to subscription pricing.
Since then, price hikes and an embrace of artificial intelligence have all added to the vitriol many photographers and creatives direct toward the company.
“The past few years of minimal communication with the community at large followed by the tidal wave of bad press over the past six months has left Adobe’s standing with many photographers in shambles,”
PetaPixel’s
editor-in-chief Jaron Schnieder
wrote last year
.
“Adobe couldn’t explain why it let its once excellent relationship with photographers and media lapse, only that it is sorry that happened.”

data.title: Erlang's not about lightweight processes and message passing (2023)
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 文章主要讨论了Erlang编程语言的核心思想，并纠正了一个常见误解：Erlang的精髓不仅在于轻量级进程和消息传递，而在于其“行为”（behaviours）机制。文章回顾了Erlang的历史，最初是用于构建可靠的分布式系统，后来在Ericsson内部发展并最终开源。作者指出，Joe Armstrong的博士论文揭示了Erlang的真正核心——通过“行为”实现通用组件，从而构建可靠的系统。文章通过对比Go语言的接口示例和Erlang的`gen_server`行为示例，说明“行为”类似于接口，但更强调其在系统可靠性方面的作用。这表明Erlang的创新在于通过“行为”实现模块化和容错性，而不仅是进程和消息传递。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Erlang及其相关技术（如BEAM、OTP）的特点和优势

不同观点：
• bcardarella：Erlang的最大优势在于用更少的开发资源构建复杂系统，尤其是通过OTP和轻量级进程模型。他还提到Elixir在iOS设备上的应用以及通过C语言与Erlang节点通信的实践。
• hinkley：认为Erlang的轻量级进程和消息传递是不可分割的特性，强调Erlang的Communicating Sequential Processes模型。对有人忽略这些特性表示失望。
• unoti：关注Erlang在可视化流程编程（FBP）中的应用，提出了将Node-RED前端与Erlang后端结合的想法，并质疑为什么之前没人做过类似项目。
• travisgriggs：强调Erlang/Elixir的精简和高效，认为其设计思想在软件世界中未得到充分重视。
• senderista：强调Erlang/BEAM的部分恢复功能，认为这是其生产系统中的一流概念。
• HeavyRain266：指出Erlang/BEAM/OTP的综合优势，包括虚拟机类似虚拟内核、分布式模式、Mnesia数据库等特性，并分享了其公司在BEAM内部替换TCP堆栈和集成Rust补丁的经验。
• jerf：认为其他语言不应直接复制Erlang的行为接口，而应根据各自语言特性进行适配，强调理解Erlang背后的设计思想而非直接移植。
• throwawaymaths：认为Erlang的错误处理和行为组合是其核心优势，特别是在分布式系统中处理错误和异常状态。
• kamma4434：不同意将行为视为接口，强调Erlang行为依赖于其底层架构，特别是进程隔离和资源管理。
• layer8：对Erlang的状态处理和外部状态（如数据库、队列、文件系统）的管理有疑问，寻求相关解释。
• LtdJorge：强调Erlang运行时的抢占式调度器是其关键优势，使得消息传递和轻量级进程更加高效。
• spott：提问学习Erlang是否能带来新的思维方式，或者只是让人希望其他语言也具备Erlang的特性。
• coldtea：认为Erlang的最大特点不仅仅是轻量级进程和消息传递，而是其“编排/监督”功能。

补充讨论：
• 关于Ericsson停止使用Erlang的原因和Joe被解雇的背景信息，unoti提供了详尽的描述，指出这与公司战略转变和市场环境变化有关。
• Supersaiyan_IV：纠正关于Ericsson禁止使用Erlang的错误陈述，指出Ericsson仍在某些产品中使用Erlang。

争议焦点：
• Erlang的核心优势到底是什么，不同评论者有不同看法，包括资源高效利用、轻量级进程和消息传递、部分恢复功能、底层架构和调度器等。
• 是否应该直接复制Erlang的设计思想和接口到其他语言，jerf和throwawaymaths持反对意见，认为应根据语言特性进行适配。

43655221.article_content:
Erlang’s not about lightweight processes and message passing…
Posted on Jan 18, 2023
I used to think that the big idea of Erlang is its lightweight
processes and message passing. Over the last couple of years I’ve
realised that there’s a bigger insight to be had, and in this post I’d
like to share it with you.
Background
Erlang has an interesting history. If I understand things correctly,
it started off as a Prolog library for building reliable distributed
systems, morphed into a Prolog dialect, before finally becoming a
language in its own right.
The goal seemed to have always been to solve the problem of building
reliable distributed systems. It was developed at Ericsson and used to
program their telephone switches. This was sometime in the 80s and 90s,
before internet use become widespread. I suppose they were already
dealing with “internet scale” traffic, i.e. hundreds of millions of
users, with stricter SLAs than most internet services provide today. So
in a sense they were ahead of their time.
In 1998 Ericsson decided to ban all use of Erlang
1
.
The people responsible for developing it argued that if they were going
to ban it, then they might as well open source it. Which Ericsson did
and shortly after most of the team that created Erlang quit and started
their own company.
One of these people was Joe Armstrong, which also was one of the main
people behind the design and implementation of Erlang. The company was
called Bluetail and they got bought up a couple of times but in the end
Joe got fired in 2002.
Shortly after, still in 2002, Joe starts writing his PhD thesis at
the Swedish Institute of Computer Science (SICS). Joe was born 1950, so
he was probably 52 years old at this point. The topic of the thesis is
Making reliable distributed systems in the presence of software
errors
and it was finished the year after in 2003.
It’s quite an unusual thesis in many ways. For starters, most theses
are written by people in their twenties with zero experience of
practical applications. Whereas in Joe’s case he has been working
professionally on this topic since the 80s, i.e. about twenty years. The
thesis contains no math nor theory, it’s merely a presentation of the
ideas that underpin Erlang and how they used Erlang to achieve the
original goal of building reliable distributed systems.
I highly commend reading his
thesis
and forming your own opinion, but to me it’s clear that the big idea
there isn’t lightweight processes
2
and message passing, but
rather the generic components which in Erlang are called
behaviours
.
Behaviours
I’ll first explain in more detail what behaviours are, and then I’ll
come back to the point that they are more important than the idea of
lightweight processes.
Erlang behaviours are like interfaces in, say, Java or Go. It’s a
collection of type signatures which can have multiple implementations,
and once the programmer provides such an implementation they get access
to functions written against that interface. To make it more concrete
here’s a contrived example in Go:
// The interface.
type
HasName
interface
{
Name
()
string
}
// A generic function written against the interface.
func
Greet
(
n HasName
)
{
fmt
.
Printf
(
"Hello %s!
\n
"
,
n
.
Name
())
}
// First implementation of the interface.
type
Joe
struct
{}
func
(
_
*
Joe
)
Name
()
string
{
return
"Joe"
}
// Second implementation of the interface.
type
Mike
struct
{}
func
(
_
*
Mike
)
Name
()
string
{
return
"Mike"
}
func
main
()
{
joe
:=
&
Joe
{}
mike
:=
&
Mike
{}
Greet
(
mike
)
Greet
(
joe
)
}
Running the above program will display:
Hello Mike!
Hello Joe!
This hopefully illustrates how
Greet
is generic in, or
parametrised by, the interface
HasName
.
Generic server behaviour
Next lets have a look at a more complicated example in Erlang taken
from Joe’s thesis (p. 136). It’s a key-value store where we can
store
a key value pair or
lookup
the value of
a key, the
handle_call
part is the most interesting:

• senderista：强调Erlang/BEAM的部分恢复功能，认为这是其生产系统中的一流概念。
• HeavyRain266：指出Erlang/BEAM/OTP的综合优势，包括虚拟机类似虚拟内核、分布式模式、Mnesia数据库等特性，并分享了其公司在BEAM内部替换TCP堆栈和集成Rust补丁的经验。
• jerf：认为其他语言不应直接复制Erlang的行为接口，而应根据各自语言特性进行适配，强调理解Erlang背后的设计思想而非直接移植。
• throwawaymaths：认为Erlang的错误处理和行为组合是其核心优势，特别是在分布式系统中处理错误和异常状态。
• kamma4434：不同意将行为视为接口，强调Erlang行为依赖于其底层架构，特别是进程隔离和资源管理。
• layer8：对Erlang的状态处理和外部状态（如数据库、队列、文件系统）的管理有疑问，寻求相关解释。
• LtdJorge：强调Erlang运行时的抢占式调度器是其关键优势，使得消息传递和轻量级进程更加高效。
• spott：提问学习Erlang是否能带来新的思维方式，或者只是让人希望其他语言也具备Erlang的特性。
• coldtea：认为Erlang的最大特点不仅仅是轻量级进程和消息传递，而是其“编排/监督”功能。

补充讨论：
• 关于Ericsson停止使用Erlang的原因和Joe被解雇的背景信息，unoti提供了详尽的描述，指出这与公司战略转变和市场环境变化有关。
• Supersaiyan_IV：纠正关于Ericsson禁止使用Erlang的错误陈述，指出Ericsson仍在某些产品中使用Erlang。

争议焦点：
• Erlang的核心优势到底是什么，不同评论者有不同看法，包括资源高效利用、轻量级进程和消息传递、部分恢复功能、底层架构和调度器等。
• 是否应该直接复制Erlang的设计思想和接口到其他语言，jerf和throwawaymaths持反对意见，认为应根据语言特性进行适配。

data.title: Silicon Valley crosswalk buttons apparently hacked to imitate Musk, Zuck voices
data.author: coloneltcb
data.article_summary: 多处十字路口的人行横道按钮在中半岛地区遭到黑客攻击，按下后会播放自称是马克·扎克伯格或埃隆·马斯克的声音。这些语音模仿了两位科技名人，发表了一些怪异言论，例如扎克伯格称“将AI强制插入你的每个意识体验是正常的”，而马斯克则开玩笑称“癌症其实很棒”。部分受影响按钮已被修复，帕洛阿托市政府已禁用语音功能。目前尚不清楚问题是否完全解决，以及黑客攻击的具体原因。加州交通部及其他相关机构尚未回应。此事正在进一步调查中。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：十字步行按钮被黑客入侵的趣味性与安全性

不同观点：
• [relistan的观点]  
   认为这个事件虽然看似有趣但实际上存在安全隐患。他指出，虽然此次行为没有造成实际伤害，但其他人可能利用这个漏洞进行恶意操作。这些设备是用于保障安全的重要工具，存在被黑客入侵的风险是不容忽视的问题。

• [ryandrake的观点]  
   认为这是一次无害的恶作剧，并且带有正义性质，专门针对那些“该被恶搞”的人。他支持这种行为，并希望恶作剧者能继续保持低调，避免被发现和惩罚。

• [jimmydoe的观点]  
   对技术细节表现出兴趣，推测大多数类似十字步行按钮可以通过一个应用程序进行配置。他猜测，黑客可能是通过泄露的认证信息或物理手段进行入侵操作的。

补充讨论：

43669151.article_content:
Getting your
Trinity Audio
player ready...
A crosswalk button in Redwood City plays a voice professing to be Mark Zuckerberg on April 12. Courtesy Justin Ward.
Crosswalk buttons along the mid-Peninsula appear to have been hacked, so that when pressed, voices professing to be Mark Zuckerberg or Elon Musk begin speaking.
Videos taken at multiple locations in both Redwood City and Palo Alto show various messages that begin to play when crosswalk buttons are hit. The voices appear to imitate how Zuckerberg and Musk sound.
In one video, taken on Saturday morning at the corner of Arguello Street, Broadway and Marshall Street in Redwood City, a voice claiming to be Zuckerberg says that “it’s normal to feel uncomfortable or even violated as we forcefully insert AI into every facet of your conscious experience. And I just want to assure you, you don’t need to worry because there’s absolutely nothing you can do to stop it.”
Calling all photographers!
The 2025 Six Fifty Peninsula Photo Contest is now accepting submissions! Anyone who lives, works, or attends school in the 6-5-0 area code is eligible to enter. Both youth and adults are welcome.
Learn More & Enter
In another video, taken in downtown Palo Alto early on Saturday morning, a voice claiming to be Musk says that he would “like to personally welcome you to Palo Alto.”
“You know, people keep saying cancer is bad, but have you tried being a cancer? It’s f—— awesome,” the voice goes on to say.
A crosswalk button in Palo Alto plays a voice professing to be Elon Musk on April 12. Courtesy Cynthia Neuwalder.
Another video from downtown Palo Alto shows a voice impersonating Musk saying that he would give the listener a Cybertruck if they become his friend.
“You don’t know the level of depravity I would stoop to just for a crumb of approval,” the voice says. “I mean, let’s be real, it’s not like I had any moral convictions to begin with.”
Some of the impacted crosswalk buttons were no longer playing the messages on Saturday morning, one local resident reported.
City of Palo Alto spokesperson Meghan Horrigan-Taylor said that city employees determined that 12 downtown intersections were impacted and have disabled the voice announcement feature on the crosswalks until repairs can be made. The tampering may have happened on Friday, Horrigan-Taylor said.
“Other traffic signals in the City were checked and the impact is isolated,” Horrigan-Taylor said. “Signal operations are otherwise unaffected, and motorists are reminded to always exercise caution around pedestrians.”
It is unclear whether the problem has been fixed outside of Palo Alto, how many crosswalks were impacted in total or what was the cause.
A Meta spokesperson referred questions to the cities with the impacted crosswalks. Tesla did not immediately reply to a request for comment.
The California Department of Transportation, as well as a representative from Redwood City, also did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
This story is developing and will be updated as more information is available.
If you have more information about crosswalks that have been impacted, let us know in the comments or send us an email at zmorgan@embarcaderomedia.org.

data.title: UK parliament votes to nationalize British Steel
data.author: anigbrowl
data.article_summary: 英国议会通过紧急立法，允许政府接管英国钢铁公司，以避免其位于斯肯索普的工厂关闭。该工厂是英国唯一生产原钢的地方，而其母公司中国企业京烨集团威胁关闭工厂。尽管政府提出购买原材料以维持运营，但京烨集团以财务亏损为由拒绝。紧急立法赋予政府权力，可购买原材料并寻找投资伙伴。首相基尔·斯塔默表示，此举旨在保护英国钢铁产业及工人就业。此前，美国对钢铁进口加征关税也给英国钢铁行业带来压力。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：英国政府对英国钢铁公司的管控及其历史背景

不同观点：
• [ksec] 引用了《Yes Minister》中Sir Humphrey Appleby的台词，讽刺了政府在过去几十年中政策的反复无常。观点强调，如果盲目追随所有政府的政策，个人立场会变得自相矛盾，反映出政治决策的反复和不稳定性。例子包括对共同市场、钢铁国有化、资本 punishment、经济政策（凯恩斯主义与弗里德曼理论）、教育制度和私有化等政策的反复变化。

• [rayiner] 则将讨论焦点转向当前英国政府对英国钢铁公司的干预，并将此举与历史上第三世界国家对英国的行动相比较，暗示这种干预是一种历史角色的倒置。观点强调，需要从英国如何允许这种角色转换中吸取教训，可能在质疑英国政府对外资管理和经济政策上的失策。

补充讨论：
- [ksec] 的评论更侧重于历史和政治决策的不稳定性，通过一系列具体政策变化来展示政府的反复无常。
- [rayiner] 的评论则更关注当前事件，并将当前情况与历史进行对比，隐含对英国政府政策和管理能力的批评。
- 争议的焦点可能在于政府干预经济的正当性和有效性，以及这种干预是否反映了历史的教训或重复历史错误。

43668263.article_content:
LONDON — British MPs have approved emergency legislation empowering ministers to place British Steel under state control.
The dramatic intervention — interrupting the parliament's Easter recess — followed a tense standoff with Chinese firm Jingye, British Steel’s parent company.
Jingye had threatened to shut its operations in the northern English industrial town Scunthorpe, resisting an offer to stock the site with the raw materials needed to keep the furnaces running. The plant is the sole remaining source of virgin steel in Britain.
Advertisement
Advertisement
The legislation subsequently went to the House of Lords, where later Saturday it was voted through without amendments.
The legislation will give the U.K. government “the power to direct steel companies in England, which we will use to protect the Scunthorpe site,” Downing Street said in a statement.
The measure will give the government the authority to purchase the raw materials needed to keep the U.K.’s last blast furnaces burning as it seeks a partner to co-invest in the site.
"I know how important steel is to the whole country," U.K. Prime Minister Keir Starmer said in a
post on X
. "We will act to secure Britain's future."
Despite multiple government offers to purchase the necessary materials, the company resisted, saying the two blast furnaces were "no longer financially sustainable," and citing six-figure daily financial losses from keeping them open.
The government was already under pressure to support the sector after U.S. President Donald Trump imposed a 25 percent levy on all steel imports.
Ministers will hope that taking control of the site will be seen as a sign that the U.K. is stepping up to protect its workers after Starmer described Trump’s trade war as marking the end of the globalization era, and vowed to demonstrate the value of active government.

data.title: WebRTC for the Curious
data.author: sebg
data.article_summary:
《WebRTC For The Curious》是一本开源书籍，由WebRTC的实现者编写，旨在分享他们的知识。本书侧重于协议和API，总结RFC并收集未文档化的知识，采用与厂商无关的视角，且非教程性质，代码示例较少。它适合希望深入了解WebRTC的开发者、当前使用WebRTC但想超越API理解的开发者、以及需要调试帮助和特定部分澄清的WebRTC实现者。

本书结构设计为可多次阅读，每章独立，回答一个核心问题，并提供三个层次的信息：需解决的问题、解决方案及技术细节、进一步学习资源。无需 prior knowledge，可在任何章节开始学习。书籍可在GitHub和WebRTCforTheCurious.com免费下载，采用CC0许可，无需署名。欢迎贡献和提出改进建议。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：WebRTC技术及其应用、优势、挑战和生态系统

不同观点：
• Valorzard认为WebRTC数据通道是非常被低估的技术，尤其是在网页上实现类似UDP的功能，并且能够控制其可靠性。然而，由于生态系统不完善、涉及过多不必要的样板代码，他没有继续使用。但他指出WebRTC对于网页多玩家游戏来说是最佳选择，并分享了一个使用WebRTC开发的游戏项目。

• Sean-Der对WebRTC表示高度赞赏，并指出WebRTC的应用场景非常广泛，远超网页领域，如远程控制挖掘机、安全摄像头、工厂机器人等。他参与编写了《WebRTC for the Curious》，并欢迎其他人提出改进建议。

• Hnlurker22以幽默的方式表达了对《WebRTC for the Curious》书名的赞赏，但没有提出具体的技术观点。

• Adhamsalama认为《WebRTC for the Curious》缺乏代码示例，对他帮助不大。他最终通过参考其他书籍和旧代码重写了TypeScript项目，并分享了使用WebRTC和WebAssembly实现的点对点协作SQLite数据库项目。

• Quantadev分享了一个关于WebRTC聊天应用的Reddit链接，并提到WebRTC可以与Nostr协议结合使用，用于传递加密消息。

• Amelius提出了WebRTC技术是否能够穿透企业防火墙的问题，这是一个关于WebRTC实际应用中的技术挑战的疑问。

补充讨论：
